# Nordpaket: price adjustment 2027 (customer notice, forwarded by ops)

> Dear business customer,
>
> our parcel prices for 2027 take effect on 1 January 2027. On average, base rates rise by
> 4.9 %; the change differs by zone and weight bracket. The fuel surcharge stays at 8.5 %.
>
> The complete 2027 rate card is available through the rate-card API
> (`/v2/rate-cards/2027`) from 10 November 2026. Invoices from 1 January 2027 are
> calculated on that card. From 2027 every card the API serves carries its identifier in the
> `cardId` field, and our invoices quote it: the 2027 card is `NP-RC-2027-LCVGU`.
>
> Your Nordpaket business team
